definition: The July 2018 GTA Online update that let players buy and run nightclubs with four real resident DJs.
A real DJ recreated in GTA Online through motion capture, playing a custom mix in player-owned clubs.
The After Hours station (LSUR) that loops the four residents' mixes and selections; it opened with a Solomun mix.
Recording a performer's movement with suits and cameras to animate their character; Rockstar captured each resident playing a live set.
An underground club beneath The Diamond Casino, added with The Cayo Perico Heist in December 2020, with Moodymann, Keinemusik and Palms Trax as residents.
Joy Orbison's station from The Cayo Perico Heist, tied to a mission placing antennas around the map.
A record label announced on May 24, 2021 as a joint venture between CircoLoco and Rockstar Games.
A radio-wheel slot added with Los Santos Tuners in July 2021 that plays collectible media sticks.
An in-world collectible USB drive that unlocks a mix or EP in the Media Player.
Seth Troxler's mix unlocked by finding all four Monday Dreamin' EP media sticks.
Moodymann's media-stick mix from Los Santos Tuners, found in his character Kenny's car at the LS Car Meet.
The in-game studio at the center of The Contract's Dr. Dre storyline.
The stretch when a track exists only in the game before it reaches streaming; about seven weeks for Dr. Dre's Contract songs.
Mission music split into stems that gameplay mixes live, as in the Soulwax and Nick Hook score for Los Santos Drug Wars.
